original_question: Wani kamfani yana kashe $15000 kan talla har tsawon shekara guda, sannan ya kashe kashi uku na wannan adadin akan talla har tsawon shekara guda. Menene jimillar kuɗin da kamfani ya kashe kan talla tsawon shekaru biyu?
question_template: Wani kamfani yana kashe ${num_digit_1, 15000} kan talla har tsawon shekara guda, sannan ya kashe {num_frac_1, sulusi} na wannan adadin akan talla har tsawon shekara guda. Menene jimillar kuɗin da kamfani ya kashe kan talla tsawon shekaru biyu?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * (1 + f1)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
